questions.answer: Very easy, used Wihast, fine but nothing special. A flat through can wg-gesucht can be very nice, but never know for sure what you get

Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: You get a buch of emails during the spring/summer, with things you have to do

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: There is an email you can write to, if you have questions

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Got all the classes I wanted

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: just keep pushing for what you want, by sending emails, you will get it in the end

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Very mixed levels in classes, and the exam period can be quite stressfull, since you dont get a study break up to the exams.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: bachelor levels and master-courses. However the master-courses were easier, but also taking outside of the math-department, so perhabs that why

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Pretty much the same, more class participation here

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Applied Optimization, Entscheidungs- und Spieltheorie, Linear, Nonlinear and Integer Optimization, Microeconomics II, Angewandtes Maschinelles Lernen, Finanzmathematik

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Applied Optimization, great teacher
